caption: All specifications retain the same 633 PRs, including isolates. URL and explicitly prefixed PR-number text are mention proxies, not proven inheritance. Removing future-at-opening or same-account pairs is a sensitivity analysis. The surviving current-body links still have unknown historical availability. Table directions are cited antecedent → citing PR.

Selected purposive examples, not frequency estimates. Boxes distinguish PR containers from comment contributions and source versions. Arrows encode audited source-relative semantic roles; none establishes global novelty or independent scientific truth. Full exact excerpts and URLs are in the companion relation/member tables and dashboard evidence desk.

Ten source-reported conditional κ records in three purposively selected series. Each panel has its own y scale. Lines only join audited semantic pairs within each series and do not define a comparable or validated frontier. All claim-first-visible dates are unknown: PR opening is a navigation coordinate. The #633 square reproduces #627 and is not a new bound. Headline κ is separate from practical speed, theorem validity, merge state and scientific credit.

Twelve most prolific PR author accounts; account IDs are not identities or AI-role labels. Reach is the union of antecedent and citing counterparties in the body URL+shorthand graph. Gray ranges use 200 permutations of author labels within UTC opening days, preserving daily author PR totals and the reference graph. They are a descriptive exposure sensitivity, not confidence intervals, p-values or evidence of intellectual transfer. Communication and audit roles remain separate in the complete table.

Distinct reach excludes the starting node and repeated walks; paths are reference paths, not validated intellectual transmission. SCC condensation is a structural DAG and can have an abstract depth, but PR-level cycles may reflect mutual citation, revisions, or citation style. No historical generation or causal ordering is recovered. Complete input IDs accompany every 1–3-hop feature in the CSV, and community resolution sensitivity is exported separately.
